rice.basisNote: PSD production is milled rice; Rough Production (attribute 054) is a separate concept and is not mapped.

geography.idFormat: {system}:{code} for source geographies (e.g. usda-psd:US); wfl:world for the WFL-derived world aggregate
geography.typeAssignment: By source code via this registry only, never inferred from display names. Unlisted usda-psd codes are type country; their ISO codes are null until explicitly mapped (FAS codes are not ISO codes, e.g. CH=China, UP=Ukraine, RS=Russia).

usda-psd:E4.composition: Provider's contemporary EU aggregate; membership changes over time; United Kingdom reported separately from market year 2016; member states have no separate rows after 1998.

usda-psd:E2.composition: Historical aggregate before E4; never combined with E4.

wfl:world.derivation: Coverage-validated sum of usda-psd geographies for the market year; EU aggregate counted once, never with member rows. A WFL cross-check or explicitly labelled fallback, not an official USDA world total.

worldAggregatePolicy.preferredCanonical: Official USDA world aggregate when available and comparable in commodity, basis, units, marketing year and source release.
worldAggregatePolicy.derivedRole: WFL-derived world totals are cross-checks, or explicitly labelled coverage-validated fallback when no comparable official aggregate is accessible.
worldAggregatePolicy.coverage: Use a reviewed year-specific geography baseline; absent countries stay missing. Never normalize incomplete contributor coverage or label a derived total official.

representation.sourceId: source market-year identifier as published (usda-psd: integer start year, e.g. 2026)
representation.label: normalized display, e.g. 2026/27
representation.startMonth: null unless a reviewed source table supplies it; never assumed

marketingYear.caveat: A label such as 2026/27 is a source-reported identity, not a common calendar window: market years start in different months by country and commodity. Cross-country comparison must show this limitation.

releaseIdentity.sourceRelease: Verified bulk snapshot vintage, identified from current/latest-market-year release metadata (e.g. 2026-09); historical rows may have older last-update months. Preserve rowLastUpdatedMonth separately; do not rewrite it to the snapshot vintage.
releaseIdentity.monotonicity: For the same observation/source/dataset, reject older snapshot vintages regardless of retrieval time. Same-vintage identical raw hash is unchanged; changed bytes require source-authenticated ordered revisionSequence, otherwise quarantine and retain previous accepted data.
releaseIdentity.dataRelease: Bound by the existing immutable release pipeline (release-manifest.json releaseId and the data-release commit); no parallel release identity.

metrics.note: Component of production; excluded from the aggregate core to avoid counting one signal twice.
Source value, never recomputed. Zero yield with zero area is not-applicable. Rice yield basis (rough vs milled) must be verified against Production/Area in G1.1 before display.
metrics.zeroRule: not-applicable when harvestedArea is 0; validation flag when harvestedArea > 0

metrics.note: Equals the prior year's ending stocks; excluded from the aggregate core.
Higher use can mean demand pressure or larger available supply; no polarity without separate review. Soybean source has negative values (residual accounting); kept with a quality flag.
Market-year basis. TY Exports (113) is trade-year and is not mapped. Opposite meaning for exporters and importers; no automatic label.
Market-year basis. TY Imports (081) is trade-year and is not mapped.
Excluded from aggregate core because it reuses ending stocks. Retained as a separate metric. For exporters, domestic-use stocks-to-use ignores export demand; shown with that caveat.
unknownWhen: domesticUse missing, unavailable, zero, negative or not-applicable

conversions.rule: Source unit must equal the mapped unit exactly; otherwise the commodity is unavailable (no silent conversion). usda-psd values are already canonical, so v1 conversion is identity.

missingVsZero.rule: Zero is a reported value; missing is an absent row. Never substitute 0 for missing.
missingVsZero.usdaPsdCaveat: PSD bulk files are zero-filled matrices: every country x year x attribute has a row, so a 0 cannot be distinguished from 'not reported'. Zeros are kept as source-reported zeros, flagged sourceZeroFilled, and any percentage on a zero base is unknown.

statusTaxonomy.ok: Value present, validated and from the current expected source release.
statusTaxonomy.missing: The source release genuinely has no value for this observation (no row).
statusTaxonomy.unavailable: Retrieval, parsing or validation failed (e.g. unit changed, impossible negative). Applies per commodity or per observation; never shown as a value.
statusTaxonomy.stale: Valid value, but the source release is older than the expected release cadence.
statusTaxonomy.not-applicable: The concept does not apply (yield with zero area; direction for contextual metrics).
statusTaxonomy.conflicting: Two or more sources of equal priority report different values for the same observation; all are shown, none is chosen.
statusTaxonomy.unknown: For derived values, revisions and directions only: computation impossible (no previous release, zero or missing base, unset dead zone).

revisionModel.currentEstimate: value of the observation in the current source release
revisionModel.previousEstimate: value of the SAME observationId in the immediately preceding source release; null when there is none
revisionModel.revision: currentEstimate - previousEstimate for the SAME observationId across consecutive source releases
revisionModel.revisionPct: revision / previousEstimate x 100; unknown when previousEstimate is 0, missing or not-applicable
revisionModel.yoyChange: value(marketYear) - value(marketYear - 1) within the SAME source release
revisionModel.yoyPct: yoyChange / value(marketYear - 1) x 100; unknown on a zero or missing base
revisionModel.firstObservation: No previous release means revision, revisionPct and revision direction are unknown, never 0.
revisionModel.distinction: A revision is new information about the same year; a YoY change compares two different years. They are separate fields with separate directions.

conflicts.key: commodity x geography x marketingYear x metric
conflicts.rule: Preserve all evidence. Compare eligible finite values at the best known source tier (1 before 2 before 3); lower-tier values remain context and cannot override Tier 1. Same-tier conflicts require matching observationId, canonical unit, measurement basis, comparisonPeriod and sourceRelease. Different/missing identities or release periods are not comparable (unknown), not conflicts. Different editions from one source require revision ordering, not cross-source resolution. No automatic priority among same-tier sources.
conflicts.equality: Values are equal only if identical after canonical units at source precision.

provenance.alignment: Per commodity block, recorded with the existing data-contract record and health metadata; dataRevision and releaseId come from the existing release pipeline.

failureIsolation.rule: Each commodity is parsed, validated and published with its own status, provenance and observations. One commodity failing never fails or hides another; there is no single file-level status.

fileArchitecture.index: public/data/global-supply.json (manifest: contractVersion, per-commodity status, release, provenance, file path)
fileArchitecture.frontend: runtime fetch; never bundled into the JS build; never added to official-data.json
fileArchitecture.historyScope: Country observations for the latest three market years; official world aggregates preferred when available, WFL sums cross-check/fallback since 2000. Raw September 2026 snapshot is archived immutably for future revision comparison; historical row update months do not reconstruct complete past releases.

claim.zh: 单个指标相对上一期发布（或上一年）的变化方向，按该指标的极性解读为收紧、稳定或放松
claim.en: Direction of one metric's change versus the previous release (or prior year), read through that metric's polarity

prohibited.zh: 把多个指标合成一个分数
把方向解读为价格预测或作物受损
prohibited.en: Reading a direction as a price forecast or crop damage

prohibited.zh: 给出口、进口、国内消费自动贴收紧或放松标签
prohibited.en: Automatic tightening/easing labels for exports, imports or domestic use

interpretationRules.pendingReason: No release-to-release revision pair exists in repository history (one PSD vintage, 2026-09). Dead zones stay unset (direction unknown) until calibrated; see the spec.

interpretationRules.appliesTo: one commodity x geography x marketing year

claim.zh: 由核心指标的方向直接汇总出的供应状态，可以逐项追溯
claim.en: Supply status taken directly from core-metric directions, traceable item by item

prohibited.zh: 把面积或单产与产量重复计算
prohibited.en: Counting area or yield again alongside production

parameters.proposedRule: unknown if any core direction is unknown; mixed if both tightening and easing occur; tightening if at least one tightening and no easing; easing if at least one easing and no tightening; otherwise stable. Output always lists the metrics and their directions.

interpretationRules.pendingReason: Core is production and endingStocks only; stocksToUse is excluded to avoid duplicate stock evidence. Interpretation thresholds and aggregate adoption remain draft; not production-enabled.

legacy.GlobalFoodStress: Frozen legacy/experimental; never an input to G1 (roadmap decision 2).
